up: Return the first 1000 activity rows where the target is CHEMBL4959 (Gastrin-releasing peptide receptor). The target is a single protein from Homo sapiens (tax_id = 9606). Filter for activities with standard_type='IC50' and a pChEMBL value that is not NULL. Use only rows where the standard relation is '=' (exact values). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4959'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
